CSS URL: Paste a link to a .css file, like a raw GitHub link. It applies by itself after you paste or stop typing.
Upload CSS Files: Click Choose File and pick a .css file, and it applies right away. Use the X next to a file to remove it, or Clear to remove them all.
Raw CSS: Type or paste CSS in the box and it applies by itself after you stop typing. Empty the box to remove it.
Custom Player Color: Choose head and body colors to customize your player model. Turn the plugin on to apply them, or use Reset Colors to restore the defaults.
Role Display: Turn it on to display player roles on profiles. Turn it off to remove the role card.
Skin Texture Downloader: Turn it on to add a texture download button to skin cards. Click TEXTURE to download the original texture.
